roles.drugs: CAP outpatient, healthy: amoxicillin 1 g TID, or doxycycline, or a macrolide (only if local pneumococcal macrolide resistance <25%)
roles.note: monotherapy (ATS/IDSA 2019); amoxicillin + macrolide is not the standard for healthy outpatients
